summary: Melee hybrid built around Stormstrike windows, weapon-imbue uptime and Flurry/Maelstrom Weapon procs. Forever's biggest change for the spec: Enhancement is built around a single Two-Handed weapon instead of Classic's dual-wield, reshaping weapon imbue and stat choices.

mechanicalChanges.detail: Enhancement no longer dual-wields in Forever; the spec is balanced around one 2H weapon. This changes weapon imbue choice (one slot instead of two) and melee stat scaling vs. Classic Era.
A Shaman-only quest at level 30 rewards a powerful early 2H weapon (fist weapon or 2H mace options reported).

statPriority.rationale: Mental Dexterity gives Intellect an attack-power role, and you still need mana for Shocks and emergency healing. No beta client data contradicts Classic's stat behavior for melee.

level30: Apply the weapon imbue suited to the pull and keep Lightning Shield active. Rockbiter's threat behavior matters when a tank is holding the target.
At 25, use Stormstrike and follow with a supported Nature spell when useful. Keep Earth Shock available for its interrupt rather than spending it only for damage.
Use Flame Shock and Searing Totem for a target that survives repeated ticks.
At 30, compare Windfury Weapon against the imbue you're already using.

gearingNotes.note: Windfury is a proc — gear around the full sustained fight, not the single biggest extra-attack roll.
Forever's item files store stat types and weights, not final amounts yet — treat specific gear numbers as provisional.

recommendedBuild.leveling21pt: 5/5 Thundering Strikes, 3/3 Mental Dexterity, 2/2 Improved Ghost Wolf, 1/1 Shamanistic Focus, 3/3 Elemental Weapons, 1/3 Improved Lightning Shield, 1/1 Stormstrike, 4/5 Flurry, 1/2 Improved Stormstrike
recommendedBuild.note: Point order above is the community's best guess (explicitly "haven't been tested in game" per classicwowforever.com) — not a confirmed optimal path. Builds observed across sources skew heavily into the Enhancement tree (commonly 11/33/0-shaped at level 60) to pick up Stormstrike, Flurry, Maelstrom Weapon and Rage of the Farseer.

caveat: Forever beta, level cap 30 as of 2026-10. Most rotation/stat-priority claims are explicitly labeled 'classic-assumed' by their own source (classicwowforever.com) — meaning nothing in the beta client contradicts Classic Era behavior, not that it's been confirmed. Treat as a strong starting point, not settled fact.
